versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei·小红书公开内容情报 skill.
- Supports searching Xiaohongshu public notes by keyword, with filtering and sorting options (likes/comments/collections, time range).
- Provides note lists with engagement data; enables research on trending topics, high-engagement posts, and keyword comparisons.
- Routes requests based on user intent: keyword search, note details, comment extraction, creator monitoring.
- Clear input requirements, error messages, and handling of invalid or ambiguous cases.
- All output is structured as JSON; logs each execution for later reference.
